info.title: DevProof API
info.description: Evidence-backed career assessment & real-time repository reassessment engine

get.description: Stream real-time agent activity and reassessment updates.

Retrieve full file content and highlighted line range for an evidence citation.

Reads from file_cache at the commit/blob SHA preserved during analysis.

List public candidate repositories for a GitHub username.

Public, non-fork repos are prioritized first, sorted by recent activity (max 30).

schema.title: Response Get User Repos Api Github Users  U  Repos Get

get.description:
Return backend health, LLM connectivity, GitHub rate limits, and watcher status.

Watcher honesty (A9): watcher displays 'webhook' ONLY after a real webhook delivery
has been recorded in the database; otherwise 'polling'.

post.description: Extract structured job requirements from a URL (Greenhouse, Lever) or pasted text.

schema.title: Response Extract Job Posting Api Jobs Extract Post
Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

post.description: Save confirmed job description and its extracted requirements into the database.

get.description: Retrieve details and requirements for a specific job.

delete.description: Delete a job posting and its requirements.

schema.title: Response Delete Job Api Jobs  Id  Delete

get.description: Return Claims Matrix comparing candidate resume claims against repo assessments.

post.description:
Connect and validate a GitHub repository.

Resolves default branch HEAD SHA, computes scope preview, and records
or updates the repository row idempotently (repeated connect = one row).

get.description: Retrieve connected repository information by owner and name.

post.description: Parse candidate resume from multipart file upload or text payload, extracting claims and candidate repos.

get.description: Retrieve details and claims for a previously parsed resume.

schema.title: Response List Tracks Api Tracks Get

post.description:
Create a new track linking a job and repository with optional resume_id.

Stores the track and emits a 'track_created' event for the orchestrator.

get.description: Retrieve detailed track information by ID.

delete.description: Delete a track and its related analyses, assessments, and events.

schema.title: Response Delete Track Api Tracks  Id  Delete

post.description: Manually trigger immediate commit check and reassessment for a track.

schema.title: Response Check Now Api Tracks  Id  Check Now Post

get.description: Retrieve the latest diff/changeset for a track.

schema.title: Response Get Track Diff Api Tracks  Id  Diff Get

delete.description: Wipe all user tracks, analyses, jobs, and resumes per DATA_POLICY.md.

schema.title: Response Delete User Data Api Tracks User Data Delete

post.description: Receive and verify signed GitHub webhooks (push, ping, check_run).
